summary: Agomab Therapeutics NV filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing positive Phase 1 results for AGMB-447, an inhaled lung-restricted ALK5 inhibitor, in 10 idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis patients, plus design of the Phase 2 INSPIRIA study. A Clinical Trial Application was submitted, with study initiation intended before year-end 2026. No securities transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated; the filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer clinical update incorporated by reference into the Form S-8. Risk-arb angle: none; watch Phase 2 initiation and any subsequent financing.
